title: Watchlist – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Watchlist
hero.lead: Coaches use this area to collect players and coaches whose club affiliation and development they want to follow.

body:
Read and search the list

The number beside the heading is the total entry count. The search field filters your own list by name; when there are more than ten results, use the pagination below the cards.

  • The icon and the Player or Coach label identify the type of entry.
  • The card names the current club or marks a person who has no club. An affiliation that is due to end shows the club and end date.
  • For players, the card shows available values for matches, playing time and up to four event types.
  • The eye icon switches between visible and anonymous watching.
  • The bin removes the person from your watchlist.

Add a player or coach

  1. Select Add.
  2. In the dialogue, select Player or Coach.
  3. Enter at least two characters of the name. Kaderblick displays matching people with their current club or an indication that they have no club.
  4. Select the empty bookmark beside a result to watch that person. A filled bookmark identifies a person already on the list; selecting it again stops watching them.

Other entry points

In Players and Coaches, the bookmark beside a person adds or removes the same watchlist entry directly.

Access

In the verified demo, the watchlist is part of the coach navigation. It is the signed-in coach’s personal working list.
